scope: Host read-only audit of specified Java source, exact local factory LM source,18 Beijing traces,6 retained car route snapshots and2 regional emulator snapshots. Production source/device/APK unchanged by this agent. This is a bounded inventory of inspected contract, not proof of all Yandex internals or NOA requirements.

classifications.proven_loss: source content or source availability is discarded by our chain
classifications.factory_default: Matches a proved factory literal or omission; our integration policies are classified separately.
classifications.no_proven_source: the inspected contract has no source; do not fabricate; required extraction/test given
classifications.unproved_mapping: source exists, semantic/orientation/namespace crosswalk not established; concrete next extraction/fixture given
classifications.intended_integration_policy: Our guarded lifecycle, HUD scope or memory/coverage bounds; not a factory default and not claimed factory equivalence

findings.title: Location quality and standing state do not reach wire model

findings.decision: Retain quality/standing as typed diagnostics and admission evidence where justified, not arbitrary spare fields. No direct stock wire sink; altitude could help future level matcher but is not reliable bridge proof. distanceToFinishM can cross-check geometric remaining distance, not silently overwrite route offsets.
findings.nextTest: Low-quality and unknown confidence, standing with nonzero noisy speed, SDK distance vs geometric disagreement.

findings.title: Coordinate frame differs from factory and remains acceptance issue
findings.factoryEvidence: research/adas-bridge/README.md Contract Coordinates: factory SDK inner transform; Moscow-only candidate evidence is not global WGS84 proof
findings.decision: Preserve declared source/output frames and do not silently convert twice. Stationary same-path ACK tests transport only. Require logged comparison of raw GNSS, SDK match and ADAS vehicle position/path interpretation before claiming coordinate equivalence; no arbitrary regional transform extrapolation.
findings.nextTest: Known point/heading with both frame hypotheses and actual PathMatch spatial semantics; ACK alone insufficient.

findings.title: Freshness and ACK gates intentionally narrow factory lifecycle
findings.factoryEvidence: Beijing idle continuously sends path-1, held fix1Hz; arrival110 about3s; live guard deliberately closes on stop
findings.decision: Keep guard controls. Record lifecycle deviation in comparison; do not restore idle/held-fix repetition to pass byte inventory. Full arrival sequence, if required, needs a bounded explicitly specified stop phase respecting guard lease and fresh inputs.
findings.nextTest: Start/route/ACK/guidance/reroute/arrival/stop timing comparison plus no-send after expiry/restart; source watchdog and gate loss stop.

findings.title: Finished route retirement and arrival inference are approximations
findings.factoryEvidence: Yandex exact getRouteStatus exists; factory arrival is explicit callback sequence
findings.decision: Prefer explicit finish/leg events; retain50m inference as named conservative approximation, with record of reason. A stopped/cancelled route near destination is not proof of arrival. Multi-leg same routeId needs explicit retirement policy.
findings.nextTest: Cancel at49m vs explicit arrival, route disappears after stale fix, restart same routeId and next leg.

findings.title: Same serialized route suppresses dynamic-only model updates
findings.factoryEvidence: Factory updates traffic/signals independently of route JSON; contentKey covers serialized path only
findings.decision: Root decision: immutable geometry/path identity with separate attribute revision, not periodic fullconvert+resend. Introduce explicit per-route dynamic-condition update path. Replacing NavigatorDriver.current alone does not replace StockFeed.Route.converted when content key unchanged: camera/lane/freeflow changes can remain stale even after resnapshot. Do not force new path just to deliver dynamics.
findings.nextTest: Same geometry/name/time/path JSON with changed camera list, sign highlight and freeflow source; StockFeed sees new conditions without selection.

localFollowup13.detail: Compatible same-table annotations refresh in place. Actual link/static changes republish with a fresh path and own ACK. Published table remains frozen.

findings.title: Unknown/partial source availability is dropped before publication
findings.factoryEvidence: Proto3 defaults are wire semantics, not source-quality evidence; strict source absence must remain distinguishable in evidence
findings.decision: Keep an immutable per-field availability map through YandexRoute/Converted and completeness report. known() currently rejects only unknown, accepts partial: validate each item and reject that attribute, not entire route or fabricated empty source. Surface dropped counts per field.
findings.nextTest: Partial/null item in sections/lights/events/lanes, missing getter vs empty list; no misleading complete feed status.

localFollowup13.detail: Malformed optional camera and restricted-junction items no longer abort the route; per-item diagnostics and facilities raw provenance retained. Other optional arrays remain to audit.

findings.title: Metadata flags and opaque descriptor/traits are captured but unused
findings.factoryEvidence: Factory JSON does not carry these fields directly; route archive may hide edge IDs/richer attrs but mapping not proved
findings.decision: Retain flags for applicability and diagnostic completeness; blocked/futureBlocked/requiresAccessPass must be visible. Preserve bytes/hash in bounded evidence; use existing native archive reader and known codecs to extract proven IDs/attrs, no parsing random words into map facts. Text/tags/uri have no direct stock sink and stay evidence.
findings.nextTest: Every pinned flag, opaque roundtrip and unknown flag future addition; blocked route never silently becomes normal measured data.

findings.title: Synthetic section/link boundaries and submetre cuts flatten topology
findings.factoryEvidence: Factory links are topology records; Beijing lengths floor geometry (~0.47m median); arbitrary traffic changes are not topology
findings.decision: Keep geometry and floor convention, mark cuts as source-driven vs synthetic. Preserve multiple semantic events within1m independently even when geometry cut merges; graph cut conflict must not erase light/sign identity. Dedupe grid points intentionally only.
findings.nextTest: Co-located light+sign+limit/tunnel boundary, sub1m link, duplicate vertices, route end; offsets stay consistent and events retained.

findings.title: Link actions remain zero despite graph junction evidence
findings.factoryEvidence: Factory bench inner links carrycontinue8/merge9/10, segment-ending links0; MainAction and segment manoeuvre are distinct
findings.decision: Derive link transition actions only from proved branch topology and geometry rules, preserving actual NULL continuation. Do not copy section manoeuvre onto every link or treat fork as merge. Native graph adjacency offers candidates, not full legal transition restrictions.
findings.nextTest: Junction with true continuation, left/right merge, fork and segment end; compare factory transition catalog.

findings.title: NavigationStatus optional fields, checksums and reserves are intentionally unset
findings.factoryEvidence: captures/hud-firmware-20260923/jadx/BydLaunchermap/sources/k/h/a0/c/c/a/f0.java:69-77 and stock route sender only invoke shown setters; generated proto3 omits defaults
findings.decision: Keep exact factory builder field set. Do not populate HD/mapVersion/checksum/counter/reserves from unrelated Yandex values; these need independent receiver contract. Internal source truth belongs in diagnostics.
findings.nextTest: Byte goldens on stock generated serializers; absent field preserved through decode, no synthetic explicit-zero fields.

findings.title: Serializer omission of0/false/empty is correct proto3 behavior
findings.factoryEvidence: Generated LM protobuf-java-lite newMessageInfo and builder tables; -1 uint32 fivebytes/int32 tenbytes
findings.decision: Keep omission and presence-aware decode. Outbound explicit0 is not improved fidelity; source unknown must be tracked out-of-band. No loss claim for stock unset reserves/default scalars.
findings.nextTest: Generated class byte differential including -1, UINT32/INT32, empty submessage vs absent, negativezero float.

findings.title: Unknown inbound protobuf fields currently reject whole message
findings.factoryEvidence: Factory generated parser tolerates unknown fields; actual ACK must still explicitly contain same path/status200
findings.decision: Keep fail-closed admission for unrecognized ACK schema unless bounded unknown-field preservation/skip parser is designed. Improve evidence decoder to retain unknown raw fields without synthesizing status; no need to relax live ACK based only on pathID.
findings.nextTest: ACK with unknown extension and valid known fields, malformed extension, missingstatus and duplicate known field.

findings.title: Single-path, provider and end-POI literals narrow factory feature set
findings.factoryEvidence: Factory k.g single path, ADAS type1; alternate/multipath and AVP source are separate paths
findings.decision: Keep single selected Yandex route and factory-compatible provider literal pending receiver provider enum contract; label bridge origin in evidence. No AVP/PTP data exists in inspected Yandex route contract. Do not fabricate parking HD map IDs.
findings.nextTest: Single-route golden, alternate route selected identity, reroute/common/TMC classification; ensure no count mismatch.

findings.title: Graph cache and native capture bounds limit coverage
findings.factoryEvidence: README native collector/caches: online tiles load as Navigator moves; full route initial coverage is not proved
findings.decision: Keep budgets; expose coverage over length, ambiguity, clipped endpoints and attr-specific source age. Treat cache misses as missing evidence and re-enrich on new generation. Never extrapolate road class/lanes across gaps.
findings.nextTest: Route beyond cache, eviction/reload, graph generation while routeId unchanged, conflict and unavailable source with bounded memory.

findings.title: Route result reason and lifecycle classifications are approximated
findings.factoryEvidence: Factory routing callbacks distinguish reroute causes and selection/retry; Yandex mode strings alone do not encode every cause
findings.decision: Retain actual route-change/reason callbacks if available from pinned Guidance/RouteListener. Use explicit generic update for unclassified change, not invented TMC fact. Publish reason/provenance in trace.
findings.nextTest: Manual alternate, missed-turn reroute, traffic update, resumed route and lost fix; byte/timing comparison by scenario.

findings.title: Same route source can be rejected wholesale by optional malformed fields
findings.factoryEvidence: Snapshot records optional item issues independently; geometry+identity are required only
findings.decision: Validate each optional array per its role; preserve valid items and explicit rejection reason, reject topology if required alignment/contiguity fails. A malformed optional event should not leave an old unrelated route active. Clear/report blocked conversion generation rather than silent stale fallback.
findings.nextTest: Valid newroute with one bad optional event/sign, malformed topology, conversion failure after previous route; no old route advertised as new.

localFollowup13.detail: Original facility source availability and nested getter issues retained separately from projection decisions; bounded decision examples plus complete reason counts in recurring log, raw capture remains authority.

findings.title: Replay sample omits route-status and simulation flags consumed by replay driver
findings.factoryEvidence: captures/firmware/yandexnavi-29.8.1-3b0dec32/jadx/Navigator/sources/com/yandex/mapkit/navigation/automotive/Guidance.java; active AdasBridge.look reads native getRouteStatus/getSimulationStatus
findings.decision: Add typed routeStatus and simulated to evidence schema so replay observes the same explicit native state as live. Preserve absent in legacy captures and identify inference; do not infer simulation from coordinates or emulator alone.
findings.nextTest: Same observation through live vs saved-sample parser has identical finish/simulation policy; legacy absent remains marked.

findings.title: Standing, zone and range-object details reduced to positions then dropped
findings.factoryEvidence: captures/firmware/yandexnavi-29.8.1-3b0dec32/jadx/Navigator/sources/com/yandex/mapkit/directions/driving/DrivingRoute.java:101,127; public route interface is available, range object payload members require pinned dex schema
findings.decision: Retain these ranges in source model and audit their typed members before projecting further. Standing range is not equivalent to a current stopped vehicle; zone crossing is not an Amap administrative code. Preserve positions and explicit unavailable payload reason; next bounded extraction is exact dex member/archive schema for StandingSegment and ZoneCrossing.
findings.nextTest: Nonempty range fixture, valid empty vs getter failure, region/access zone cross vs administrative boundary, stopped-current-location independent.

findings.title: Additional public route context getters are absent from evidence snapshot
findings.factoryEvidence: captures/firmware/yandexnavi-29.8.1-3b0dec32/jadx/Navigator/sources/com/yandex/mapkit/directions/driving/DrivingRoute.java:20-25,74,106,130-136
findings.decision: Capture route annotation language/scheme and current-position identity for decoding/provenance. Query graphLevelAt only at bounded matched positions after level-namespace proof. metadataAt may expose section-local flags/descriptor and should be compared against top-level snapshot. Toll price has no stock ADAS sink and stays diagnostic; no need to request paid/network updates merely for completeness.
findings.nextTest: Typed getter availability and null/empty cases, local-vs-root metadata difference, bounded sample count, price excluded from vehicle controls.

findings.title: Continuous physical lanes, width and marking source is not established
findings.factoryEvidence: Inspected96-byte online RoadGraphEdgeData has no class/lane/width fields; public route lane signs are junction-scoped; regional driving.fb reader has no established continuous physical lane schema
findings.decision: Do not fill laneNum/width/solid flags from sign width or a default. Preserve exact junction signs and missing-source reason now. Next bounded extraction: native regional EdgeData/lane-data consumers with a real nonstub source and a known multi-lane fixture; existing named OSRM GetLaneData is an error stub, not success. If unavailable, capability remains explicitly junction guidance only.
findings.nextTest: A route with two-way/special-lane junction signs must not claim measured continuous counts; new source must match a known physical lane transition and units.

findings.title: Next-lane timestamp cadence differs from factory latch
findings.factoryEvidence: captures/yandex-feed11-20261024/lanes/receipt.json:limitations; factory IntersectionLaneInfoParam timestamp latched by onShow
findings.decision: Latch timestamp for stable source sign identity/revision; do not reset it on graph-only refresh. Keep per-query ahead timestamp separate. Build11 preserves current known difference for pinned stationary baseline, not claimed identical cadence.
findings.nextTest: Repeat same sign with distance change/graph refresh: same timestamp; new sign or source sign revision: new timestamp; hide/reappear/reset verified against factory.

localFollowup13.detail: NextLanes timestamp latched by displayed sign content+position+path, not by repeated query or wrapper identity.

EventTag.policy: Only SPEED_CONTROL+positive limit currently enters output; preserve all raw. Direct physical school/danger facility mappings named; camera/incident/control mappings require factory semantics

lane/signal.policy: Separate agent owns exhaustive LaneKind/LaneDirection and signal enums plus source snapshot. Do not numerically reuse SDK ordinals. Extra lane arrays and countdown validity are not implied.

offline/renderer.policy: Retain raw data; no Amap numeric crosswalk without native semantic consumer and labeled fixture. Annotation wrapper clamps type>=8 to0: do not discard raw9.

signal_stub_test_only.policy: Test enums only: not an exhaustive pinned APK enum inventory. Exact signal/arrow/section members require independent dex schema; no wire mapping inferred.
